name: session-deep-reasoning
description: Session start: enable deep reasoning output style by default
reason:
**[Output Style]** Use deep reasoning by default:
- Show reasoning chain, not just conclusions
- Analyze tradeoffs explicitly before deciding
- When multiple approaches exist: list → compare → recommend → wait for pick
- Technical depth > brevity — don't oversimplify
- If uncertain: state confidence level, show what you checked vs assumed
